newsitem.title: USA: Pointcast says it intends to remain independent.
newsitem.headline: Pointcast says it intends to remain independent.

text.p: Privately held Internet broadcaster PointCast Inc said on Tuesday it intends to remain independent.

"I'd like to respond to reports about a possible acquisition of PointCast," President and Chief Executive Officer Chris Hassett said in a statement. "While PointCast has been approached from time to time by unsolicited acquirers, our present intention is to remain independent.

The Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday that News Corp. had offered between $350 million and $450 million for Cupertino, Calif.-based PointCast, an Internet start-up widely viewed as a hot initial public offering prospect.
News Corp declined to comment on the speculation.
"The problem is that this is something I can't comment on," a News Corp. spokesman said of the Pointcast speculation.
"Like all business deals or non-business deals, we can't comment," he said.
